text: {"assertions":["A latency spike in ml/serving/batcher.py was caused by a cache entry that was never invalidated on write.","The latency issue only occurred for records carrying non-ASCII names.","The fix involved invalidating the cache entry inside the write transaction and was submitted as PR #4456 on branch fix/latency-spike-1.","The latency spike was visible as a tail above the median in the serving histogram.","After fixing the cache invalidation bug, job execution time improved from 4 hours to 34 minutes.","The issue can be reproduced by sending mixed-size request traces.","The test coverage for this fix is located in tests/ml/test_batcher.py."]}
